observations: Red and black gasoline generator housed in a silver-colored metal frame.
Brand 'MAXMECH' and 'GASOLINE GENERATOR' are printed on the top fuel tank section.
The control panel displays the model 'RFS15000E'.
The panel features a key-operated engine switch, an analog voltmeter, a circuit breaker, two AC 230V outlets, and DC 12V terminals.
The unit is partially wrapped in clear protective plastic.
A 'CAT' branded generator box is visible in the background.
A watermark for 'C MAX ELECTRONICS' is present on the image.

Internal alternator windings are not visible in the photo.

risks.proof: A video of the generator starting, running smoothly, and powering a significant electrical load.
A close-up photo of the alternator windings through the cooling vents showing the wire color.
A clear photo of the manufacturer's technical specification plate, usually located on the side of the alternator or engine.

proof_requests: Photo of the technical specification plate showing the rated kVA and voltage.
Video of the generator running and powering a load.
Close-up photo of the alternator windings to verify they are copper.
response.reason: The brand and model are clearly identified from the photos, allowing for a valuation at the worst-case scenario (non-functional, aluminum windings) for this specific model.
